chain.title: Meet the Gatekeeper
chain.desc: Trade a book for the Blue Journal. Its pages unlock as you explore.

chain.title: Light a Forgotten Portal
chain.desc: Buy a Zeal Lighter from the Gatekeeper and activate the portal near his house.

chain.title: Under an Unsetting Sun
chain.desc: Enter the cold Everbright. Establish a return route before seeking the Summoner's tower.

chain.title: Beneath the Red Dawn
chain.desc: Enter the warm Everdawn. Prepare for poison and fire before searching its dungeons.

chain.title: Keys to the Towers
chain.desc: Explore a Blinding Dungeon and collect its keys to reach the boss chamber.

chain.title: The Everbright Tower
chain.desc: Defeat the Summoner. His defeat opens the Nature Dungeon route.

chain.title: The Everdawn Tower
chain.desc: Defeat the Alchemist. His defeat opens the Poison Dungeon route.

chain.title: Through the Nature Maze
chain.desc: Search each floor of the Nature Dungeon for its key before ascending.

chain.title: Down into the Nest
chain.desc: Search the Poison Dungeon's floors for keys as you descend toward its guardian.

chain.title: Fell the Living Fortress
chain.desc: Bring an axe to bypass the Crusher's defenses. A spear can create an opening.

chain.title: Queen of the Poison Dungeon
chain.desc: Face the Arachnarch. Blocking her lunging attack can give you an opening.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Gatekeeper introduction and the separate Everbright and Everdawn dungeon routes.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
